intro: Shadow of the Past is an Alliance investigation quest leading from City Architect Baros Alexston to Master Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Following inquiries into a mysterious visitor who spoke with the imprisoned Defias leader Bazil Thredd, the trail shifts from public construction scandals into Stormwind's covert intelligence network.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I really haven't a clue, friend. There is someone else who might be able to help you, and it so happens that he owes me a favor for—well, let's not get into that. Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7 can be found in the barracks in Old Town. Shaw has his thumb on most of the shady, or underhanded dealings of the city.
If anyone knows, it'd be him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings. Of what service can I be to you, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: What? What's this? Yes, I think I do know who this man is, but his name is not Maelik. Assassins wear many names and many masks, discarding them as they lose their usefulness. Another alias known to be used by this man is Marzon; though even that is surely not his true name.
Regardless, he is an assassin and I know a good deal about him.
Marzon is currently under the employ of Lord Gregor Lescovar, a lord of shady reputation, even given the corruption of the nobility of Stormwind.
